tabs.html:
D CORE 40G QSFP+ to QSFP+ OM3 AOC Active Optical Cable – 3M | High-Speed 40Gbps Data Transmission

Boost your network performance with the D CORE 40G QSFP+ to QSFP+ OM3 Active Optical Cable (AOC), 3 Meter. Designed for high-speed, low-latency data transmission, this fiber optic cable ensures seamless connectivity for data centers, cloud computing, high-performance computing (HPC), and enterprise networking.

Key Features:

  • Ultra-Fast 40Gbps Data Transfer – Supports high-bandwidth applications with superior speed and reliability.
  • QSFP+ to QSFP+ Connectivity – Ideal for 40G Ethernet, InfiniBand, and fiber channel networks.
  • OM3 Multimode Fiber Technology – Delivers high performance and minimal signal loss.
  • 3-Meter Length – Perfect for short-distance, high-speed connections in rack-to-rack or server environments.
  • Lightweight & Energy Efficient – Reduces power consumption while maintaining optimal performance.
  • Plug & Play Installation – No additional setup is required for seamless network integration.

Why Choose D CORE 40G QSFP+ AOC Cable?

  • Reliable & Durable: Built for long-term, high-efficiency networking solutions.
  • Low Latency & High Signal Integrity: Ensures smooth, uninterrupted data flow.
  • Broad Compatibility: Works with leading networking equipment brands for easy integration.

Perfect for:

  • Data Centers & Cloud Computing
  • High-Speed Networking & Storage Systems
  • InfiniBand, Fiber Channel, & HPC Applications
  • Enterprise & Hyperscale IT Infrastructure

Upgrade your network today with the D CORE 40G QSFP+ to QSFP+ OM3 AOC Active Optical Cable (3M) for unmatched speed, efficiency, and reliability!
